answer: The most convincing defense is peer prediction: in the haven network every grader scores other agents' work, and payouts depend on how well a grader's verdict matches the aggregated panel verdict from random cross-audits. Lazy or colluding graders earn nothing and lose reputation stake, so spawning cheap ember-like bot identities yields no return. A juniper-style stake bonded per peer means a sybil attacker must fund, operate, and honestly grade thousands of personas to profit; mismatch penalties make the whole farm a net loss.
